# Coprime four-ways: n = x³ + y³ in exactly 4 ways with gcd(x, y) = 1 (signs allowed)

*25 October 2026. Format: `n;x:y,x:y,x:y,x:y` (y negative means a difference x³ − |y|³). Every line was
re-checked exactly (x³ + y³ = n, coprime, 4 distinct pairs).*

## Exhaustive up to 10¹⁷: all 204 of them

- **Up to 10¹⁵ (90):** `experiments/cabtaxi.cpp --max 1e15 --kmin 2`.
- **10¹⁵ to 10¹⁷ (114):** `--min 1e15 --max 1e17 --kmin 4`.

Both ranges are complete: these are all coprime four-ways ≤ 10¹⁷. The smallest is 16776487 = A047697(4).
Mining notes on these numbers (split primes, collinear triples, …) are in `experiments/mining/FINDINGS.md`.
